summary: v1.4.1 frontend patch validated end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL. All requested UX additions work correctly and no regressions from v1.4.0 were found.
verified_features: Build meta shows 'v1.4.1 · 2026-02-19' bottom-right; no console errors on load.
Tag Manager → Wildlife → expand Mammals: 'Nested under: Wildlife › Mammals' breadcrumb rendered inside expanded body with the trailing segment bold in earth-tone.

Green-tinted callout inside expanded body: 'Turn all 4 filename tag(s) on "Mammals" into nested sub-folders.' with data-testid nested-bulk-convert-wf-sub-mammals. Clicking fires window.confirm; on accept ALL 4 tags removed from filename list AND appear as 4 new nested rows (portrait, action, feeding, closeup) with empty filename tag lists.

Right-click on filename tag chip subfolder-item-wf-sub-mammals-wf-mm-1 opens context menu with '→ Nest this tag (make it a sub-folder)' (data-testid subfolder-item-ctx-nest). Clicking + confirm removes tag from list and adds it as a new nested row.
Header 'Filename tags for "Mammals"' area shows a 'Convert all → nested' button with data-testid subfolder-bulk-nest-wf-sub-mammals whenever tag count ≥ 1.

Inside NestedSubfolderEditor, per-tag promote arrow present as data-testid nested-tag-promote-<tagid>. Clicking + confirm promotes the tag into a grandchild of that nested node (verified: added 'playerA' under portrait → appeared as a grandchild sub-folder).
Main window: after picking Mammals chip, a second row appears whose LEFT label reads 'MAMMALS →' (from parent name, not generic 'Level 2').

Main window: subfolder-breadcrumb pill visible above the cascade with text 'Path: Wildlife › Mammals'. Live-updates to 'Path: Wildlife › Mammals › portrait' after drilling one level. Disappears when selection cleared (chain.length===0 branch).
Pre-existing v1.4.0 testids nested-subfolders-toggle and template-save-custom-btn are still present. template-custom-chips/template-error only render conditionally which is expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: SubfolderBar depth-1+ label uses fallback 'Level N' only when parentPathLabels last entry is empty — since SubfolderCascade always passes parent names for known chain entries, the fallback path is effectively dead but harmless.
Minor UX: On breadcrumb pill and 'Nested under:' strip, the '›' separator uses text-dim which contrasts well; last segment in earth-tone is legible on the dark theme. No issue.
NestedSubfolderEditor duplicates tag-promote logic between per-tag inline handler and top-level promoteTagToNested. Consider extracting to reduce duplication in a future refactor (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: None; used the built-in Wildlife starter pack's Mammals sub-folder with 4 filename tags.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.4.1 patch is verified end-to-end. Key testids: nested-bulk-convert-<sfid>, subfolder-bulk-nest-<sfid>, subfolder-item-ctx-nest, nested-tag-promote-<tagid>, subfolder-breadcrumb, palette-row-subfolder-l<depth>. Remember to attach page.on('dialog', d=>d.accept()) since every conversion routes through window.confirm.
